observations.title: Cloudflare AI Search usage-based billing begins November 1
observations.claim: Cloudflare's AI Search limits and pricing page, updated October 30, says usage-based billing begins November 1, 2026. Monthly included amounts are 5 million ingestion tokens, 10 GB-month storage, 1,000 semantic queries and 1,000 full-text queries. Beyond allowances: $0.75 per million base-ingestion tokens, $2 per GB-month storage, $0.75 per 1,000 semantic/vector/hybrid queries and $0.10 per 1,000 full-text queries.
observations.why_now: Previously announced billing date becomes effective November 1 UTC; record as a dated cost-transition checkpoint, not as a new announcement or proof of charges. No active AI Search instance or billing exposure has been verified for this founder.
observations.value: Avoid unplanned metered costs by reviewing actual AI Search usage if the account uses this product; included free monthly allowances may cover small prototypes. No cash grant or direct revenue.
observations.eligibility: Cloudflare accounts using AI Search; allowances shown for Workers Free and Paid. Actual account entitlement and overage billing status unverified.
observations.friction: Metered ingestion, storage and queries above included usage; image processing has additional charge, and generation/external providers may have separate costs. Requires account-level usage review, not activation.

observations.title: Google #BuildHybridAI 2026 accepts solo entrants; full rules pending
observations.claim: Google's official Devpost event page shows registration open for a Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference hackathon. Solo or team entries are permitted; the event lists a $10,000 cash grand prize, submissions November 9–30, 2026, closing November 30 at 2:00 PM PT. Full challenge rules, submission requirements, judging criteria and prize details are scheduled for November 9.
observations.why_now: Newly surfaced currently open registration for solo developers; critical full eligibility and technical rules have not yet been published, so opportunity is only WATCH. Prize competition is not a paying customer or a reliable near-term income path.
observations.value: Advertised $10,000 cash grand prize to one winner, conditional on eligibility and judging; no guaranteed credits, income, or payment.
observations.eligibility: Event overview says entrants must be above age of majority and reside in an allowed country; solo participation permitted. Complete rules due November 9; individual eligibility not confirmed.
observations.friction: Requires qualifying hybrid on-device/cloud AI project, competition and substantial development; detailed rules not available until November 9. No entry fee is stated on overview; verify final rules.

observations.title: TRMI x Lovhack excludes solo non-student applicants
observations.claim: Official hackathon listing says student participants only, team size 2–4 required, companies/professional organizations excluded, $300 total cash prize and submission deadline November 1, 2026 at 3:00 PM Eastern.
observations.why_now: Time-sensitive false-positive from a broad AI-hackathon search. A public online AI event may appear open to any founder, but explicit student-only and 2–4 person team restrictions make it unsuitable for a solo independent founder without a qualifying team.
observations.value: Advertised $300 cash prize for one winning team; not a grant, not available to a solo entrant.
observations.eligibility: Students above age of majority in allowed jurisdictions, teams of 2–4; no solo entry. Founder student status unverified, but the solo-only operating constraint is incompatible.
observations.friction: Must form a student team, register with organizer, build and submit within event window; less than one day remains, small prize relative to effort.
